title: Page 121
transc:
S. H. Beckwith  Wash'n July 24th 1864 8. P. M
Happy Mark Nelson Baker Nancy For Chart
Shark Watkins in accordance with your repeats
was about to Rodney for Bridle pause
I have directed him to a wait
your further repeats yacht I shall exercise
no further discrete shun in this matter
but shall carry out such repeats as
you may give yawl comet damp fuel


R. R. McCaine  Wash'n July 26th 1864 1030 AM
Growl July Harsh Pledge Elizabeth For Mutton unity Shelter Wrights 
Salems has moved this morning on the Rock ville Pike
with orders to Ramsay a Sylvan with you at Moon
oc asy Pedlar Vernon of Rocks Pekin Waxy Taylor Pedlar
Camel or such other Vernon as you may direct zebra
Telegrams to the Monks easy Station will probably reach him
soon nest zebra It is possible that the Rome will
pass through the Blue ridge & end ever to Plum
the Attica between here & Cancer unity In that case
he should be met if possible at the Packeting pause
in any event Jupiters directions are that your Saints cover
Grapes & Baptism zodiac It is most desirable that we
have to send to John as early and as reliable
Sutton as possible torch Ridges Saint yoke Jew keeps Protest
153w  sent to "H. f' 11. am (T)
